title: What to do after a dream reading
intro: Insight becomes useful when you give it a small place in ordinary life.

sections.heading: Write one line
sections.body: Capture the meaning that feels most alive.

sections.heading: Watch the week
sections.body: Notice what changes in your choices or attention.

sections.heading: Return if needed
sections.body: A follow-up can explore a new dream or a pattern that continues.
